Telangana Man Kills Six Family Members, Including Children

A man accused under the POCSO Act in Telangana has allegedly killed six members of his family, including two children. The victims included relatives who had reportedly filed a complaint against him. The incident has drawn attention to the prevalence of POCSO cases in the state.
